title: Budgeting and Expenses
grammar: Numerals, Fractions, Percentages & Correlative Comparisons in Economics
goal: I can talk about a budget: income, expenses and savings.
I can say what percentage or fraction of an amount something is.
I can say what I spend money on and how much I save.
